content:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT CREATED] INC-2141 — Observed spike in 5xx errors for /v1/generate on redwood-generation-prod. Severity: P1. Pager: @Alex G. War room: https://warroom.redwood.internal/INC-2141 :rotating_light:

Alex G: seeing ~12-18% 5xx rate starting 12:03 UTC, error signature is "kv-cache-miss" then OOM in runtime logs. Rolling errors across multiple instances in us-west-2.

Liz S: Ack, joining war room. Can you paste the first bad log snippet?

Alex G: paste from host-77:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z ERROR runtime - kv-cache miss -> fallback path
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z ERROR inference - runtime: OOM while executing attention_kernel (gpu0)
2026-03-15T12:03:12Z WARN  proxy - upstream returned 502
```

Maria H: I'm on pager and jumping into the war room. Quick question — is Dedicated/Dedicated customers affected or just Hosted?

Jamal R: Preliminary metrics: only hosted API generation path, embedding and rerank unaffected. Error rate concentrated on model variants with long context (>2k tokens). No dedicated pools flagged yet.

Sam P: Noted. Customer impact estimate: ~3% of total generation traffic, but affects several high-QPS customers in us-west-2. Severity P1 reasonable.

Liz S: Paging confirmation: @Maria H confirmed on-call. @Alex G will lead triage. @Jamal R to assemble metrics + baseline. Sam prepare status page draft.

Maria H: On it — in war room now. Actions: 1) replicate the OOM locally on a stale instance, 2) scale down long-context model variant traffic by routing to shorter-context fallback, 3) consider rolling restart of affected workers.

Alex G: Starting with safe mitigation: enable fallback routing for model-id: redwood/generation-xl-long to redwood/generation-xl-short for us-west-2. Command we use in routerctl:
```
routerctl set-route --region us-west-2 --model redwood/generation-xl-long --fallback redwood/generation-xl-short --weight 0.15
```
I'll apply with low weight then ramp.

Jamal R: Capturing metrics dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ab12/generation-errors?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2

Sam P: Draft for status page (short): 
"We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text generation in US-West (hosted). Some requests may fail with 5xx. Engineers are investigating and we have temporary routing mitigations in place. Impact: a subset of hosted API customers. We will post updates as we have more info."

Liz S: Suggested messaging to customers (concise): 
"We are aware of an issue causing intermittent generation failures. We have implemented temporary mitigations and are investigating root cause. No action required on your side; we will update you with ETA for full resolution."

Maria H: I'll post initial status page update now and ping support to prepare a CS template.

incident-bot: [STATUS PAGE UPDATED] INC-2141 — initial incident message posted to status.redwood.com (incident/INC-2141).

Alex G: mitigation applied: started routing 15% to short model. Observed immediate drop in 5xx to ~6% on affected instances. Continuing to ramp to 50% while monitoring.

Jamal R: collecting logs from the time window and creating an eval corpus for regression test. Need a volunteer to run a quick quantized-kernel smoke test.

Liz S: I'm happy to run smoke. Maria, keep war room open; once error rate stable <1% for 10m we can start controlled rollback to normal routing.

Sam P: CS template queued in support channel. Also recommending proactive email to top-affected customers if we see sustained impact after 30m.

Maria H: Confirming on-call handoff plan: current rotation remains with Maria for the next 2 hours, then Alex will take over if still active. Liz will remain as secondary.

Alex G: noted. Quick note for postmortem: include kernel selection logs and any recent compilers/quantization changes in last deploy.

Maria H: Thanks team — will add owner and timeline to war room. Next update in 10 min or on policy milestone. :thumbsup:
